problem: The deployed root route still rendered a two-card game picker. SLOP needs a first-run guide, deterministic personal-island generation, local persistence, a walkable 3D island, and in-world game entry while preserving direct game routes.
reuseDecision: Keep the existing Modoki shell and hub router, make the root hub route mount a separate personal-island component, preserve Parking Jam and Junkyard Station as lazy game modules, and store one versioned deterministic island snapshot behind an IslandRepository interface.
nonGoals: Implement a production account service, database, cross-device multiplayer, island editor, inventory, or house interior
Copy Animal Crossing models, UI, characters, sounds, maps, or proprietary code
Merge PR #1 or replace Modoki and Three.js
acceptance: The default root route opens the guide or a saved personal island instead of the old game-card picker
The onboarding captures seven typed preferences with emoji chips and shows five real generation stages
The deterministic generator creates a versioned island blueprint containing terrain, house, vegetation, animal, activity zone, player spawn, and both local game portals
The island snapshot survives a page reload through LocalIslandRepository
The player can move with keyboard or touch joystick, change camera mode, open the game menu, and enter either game portal
Direct Parking Jam and Junkyard Station query routes still work, and the home button returns to the personal island
Domain tests, strict TypeScript, architecture checks, code ratchets, production build, and browser route checks pass
